summary: Nightly batch job perceives recurrent inference hang due to burst-retry cascade against soft 429 enforcement window
description: Issue summary: MedNimbus alerted that their nightly inference job (high-concurrency batch of short prompts) is intermittently timing out or showing extremely long tail latencies. They see rapid retry attempts from their SDK which coincide with a spike in 429 responses and then a long apparent stall.
impact: Customer nightly processing pipeline experiences repeated failures for ~5-12 minutes during a daily window. Business impact: delayed data processing and missed alerts; customer classified as Dedicated and needs predictable throughput for SLA workloads.
timeline: 2026-03-10 01:05 UTC - MedNimbus support ticket opened; reported 'job succeeded earlier but now stalls and reports timeouts', attached SDK logs.
2026-03-10 01:18 UTC - Support triage: observed 429 spike for customer keys in prod/us-west-2 correlated with nightly job window.
2026-03-10 02:10 UTC - SRE investigated rate-limiter metrics and saw request queueing and burst enforcement on soft quota windows.
2026-03-11 10:24 UTC - Partial mitigation applied: temporary soft quota bump for customer and advisory sent to customer for SDK backoff tuning.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) In MedNimbus account (dedicated key) schedule high-concurrency batch job that fires ~2k short prompts simultaneously (10-60 token responses).
2) Use SDK v1.8.1 with default retry/backoff settings (exponential without jitter, max retries 5).

3) Observe: many initial requests receive 429 responses with 'Retry-After' omitted in a subset of responses, client retries immediately and concurrently, overall client-perceived latency increases and many requests eventually time out.
4) Re-run with client-side randomized jitter/backoff and observe significantly fewer concurrent retry waves and reduced apparent stalls.
logs: [2026-03-10T01:12:03Z] 429 response for key=acct-MEDN: {status:429, message:"soft quota exceeded", window:60s, queued:120}
[2026-03-10T01:12:04Z] sdk-js v1.8.1 retry attempt 1 for requestId=xyz (no jitter)
[2026-03-10T01:12:05Z] 429 response for key=acct-MEDN: {status:429, message:"soft quota exceeded", Retry-After:1}
[2026-03-10T01:12:06Z] sdk-js multiple concurrent retries spike; client observed 15s tail latency and several timeouts.
investigation_notes: SRE: rate-limiter meter shows burst enforcement was applied in 60s sliding windows; customer traffic pattern has a sharp ramp at 01:00 UTC causing queue growth.

SRE: the cluster returned soft-429 without consistent Retry-After headers for ~8% of 429s due to an edge-case in the rate-limiter path; SDK treats missing Retry-After as immediate retry with backoff 0 -> amplifies load.
Support: SDK version used lacks randomized jitter by default for the retry policy we recommend; customer uses default exponential that collided with the enforcement window.
Observability: dashboard (queue-length, denied-reqs) linked: https://grafana.redwoodai.com/d/alerts/soft-429-windows?var=acct=MEDN shows 3x baseline queueing during event window.
Hypothesis: soft quota window + synchronized client retry waves created a transient overload; effect looked like model hang or long-tailed latency from client's perspective.
comments: 2026-03-10 01:20 - Priya Shah (Support): Thanks for the report — we see a 429 cluster spike for your account during the job window. We're escalating to SRE to validate rate-window behavior and to check Retry-After emission.

2026-03-10 02:30 - Mateo Rivera (SRE): Found that some 429s omited Retry-After when requests were collapsed into internal queue; creating a fix ticket to ensure Retry-After is consistently set. Posting Grafana panels to thread.
2026-03-10 03:05 - MedNimbus (Customer): We're seeing our orchestrator give up after 30s; can you suggest immediate mitigations?

2026-03-10 03:20 - Ethan Morales (Support): Immediate workaround: (a) increase client-side base backoff and enable jitter, (b) reduce parallelism during the nightly window, (c) request a temporary soft quota bump — we've applied the temporary bump.
action_taken: Temporary soft quota increase for MedNimbus applied in prod/us-west-2 at 2026-03-11 10:24 UTC.
Emergency patch to rate-limiter to always include Retry-After header in 429 responses (hotfix rollout initiated, PR #2094).
Customer advised to upgrade SDK to v1.9.0 which includes recommended randomized jitter and explicit handling of absent Retry-After headers (PR #834).
Added Grafana alert to detect synchronized retry waves (threshold: denied-reqs > 2x baseline for 60s).
resolution: Partial mitigation applied: temporary quota bump and hotfix rolled for Retry-After emission. Customer SDK upgrade and client backoff tuning recommended. Long-term: SRE to smooth enforcement window duration and evaluate adaptive per-customer pacing; follow-up action assigned to infra team.
next_steps: Infra: validate smoothing change (increase enforcement window from 60s to 120s) and run chaos tests against a replicated nightly burst pattern (owner: Marco Chen, due: 2026-03-19).
SDK: ship v1.9.0 to customers and update docs to call out jittered backoff as required for high-concurrency batch jobs (owner: Aisha Khan, due: 2026-03-14).
CS: coordinate with MedNimbus to stagger nightly job or use ramped concurrency as a short-term best practice.
